tools.name: light.info
tools.description: Inspect a photo in your workspace (RAW: DNG, CR2/CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF, RW2, PEF...; or JPEG, PNG, TIFF): its size and summary, and every EXIF/TIFF/GPS tag and XMP property. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named.

tools.name: light.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the light engine's catalog, in order, on the photo at `path` in your workspace, then write the developed photo (.jpg, .png, .tif, .webp, .avif or .dng by the extension of `out`; `quality` 1 to 100, `long_edge` caps its size) to `out` when given. Each command is {id, params}. Only reviewed commands run: those the skill's commands.md lists untagged (work inside the document); anything that reaches other files, code, the network, devices or the app is refused before any command runs. Paths are relative to your workspace, and `out` must be a new file. Read the light-engine skill first.
